highlights.text: Gave a 'No Comments' response regarding Badshah during conversations in the house
Was asked 'Badshah Nahi Hai Tumhara Bhai?' by Yung DSA
Refused to comment on her relationship status with Badshah and embraced her single life.
Was highlighted by Mahhi Vij as part of the 'divorcee special' group starting a second innings.
Opened up about her breakup with Badshah and received advice from Salman Khan to move on.
Engaged in a fight with Mahhi Vij and revealed she wants to stay single.
Broke silence on divorce rumours from Badshah and expressed feeling like a 'side character' in her own story.
Salman Khan encouraged her to move on from her past relationship, telling her that 'agli party' has moved on.
